issues.description: The user is stuck on the auth page (/auth?next=%2Fdesign%2Fstep-2) instead of being redirected to /design/step-2. The auth middleware or session check is not recognizing the user as authenticated, causing a redirect loop or failed session validation. The 500 Internal Server Error in console logs suggests the Supabase session/auth endpoint is failing, which prevents the middleware from confirming authentication and redirecting to step-2.
issues.root_cause: The middleware at apps/web/middleware.ts (or equivalent) redirects unauthenticated users to /auth with ?next= parameter. The 500 error from Supabase means the session check is failing server-side, keeping the user on the auth page. Alternatively, the Supabase auth callback or session cookie is not being set correctly, so every request to /design/step-2 bounces back to /auth.

issues.description: 500 Internal Server Error logged in console. This indicates a server-side failure, likely in a Supabase API route or server component that handles session validation or data fetching for the design step-2 page.
issues.element: Console error: Failed to load resource: 500 Internal Server Error
issues.root_cause: A server route (possibly apps/web/app/api/auth/... or a Supabase server client call) is returning a 500. This could be due to missing environment variables (SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY), a misconfigured Supabase client, or a broken API route handler.
